fact: Under the one-year Vital Strategies-funded project "Strengthening Births and Deaths Registration Services within the CRVS System in Sierra Leone", NCRA trained health workers and its own staff on new technology and software and distributed 48 laptops and internet modems, each with a quarterly subscription, to 48 selected health facilities across the 16 districts; no total of facilities or offices is given.
title: NCRA DG Enhances Digital Transformation for Birth and Death Registration
